long_biography.plain_text:
Settle trained in law at Lancaster University and worked as a solicitor-advocate before establishing Joseph James Law in 2016. The practice handled consumer claims and litigation, and he held a controlling stake from its incorporation. He later led other legal-services businesses, including Sandstone Legal and Precision Solicitors.

His wider private-company interests have included Setanti Property and Investments and Fast Track Oceanic, which briefly traded as Fast Track Marine Investments. Settle also became a trustee of the Royal Society of St George Charitable Trust. A 2025 regulatory decision imposed conditions on his practising certificate, limiting him to work as an employee approved by the regulator.
